text:
Anna L.: Heads-up: main is red on linux-cpu and linux-gpu lanes. failing test: tests::kv_cache::evict. Started after libfoo 2.1.0 bump (PR #4921). Last green on main: 1765401123 (commit 3f2a9b7). Can someone help hunt the culprit/ bisect?
CI Bot: Build #12456 failed: https://ci.example.com/build/12456
Test output snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 5 got 4
  File "tests/test_kv_cache.py", line 78, in test_evict
    assert len(cache) == 5
...
```
Ryan K.: I can take this. Quick q: do we have a flaky rerun? sometimes the test flakes under heavy scheduling.
Matt P.: Not flaky here — reproduced locally using `tox -e py37 -- tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_evict` on ubuntu-22.04. Failure reproduces.
Anna L.: OK Ryan, last good commit on main before bump: 3f2a9b7. The bump PR merged at 1765428000 (commit d4c3b21).
Ryan K.: Starting a git bisect on a clone. Commands I usually run:
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/platform.git
cd platform
git bisect start d4c3b21 3f2a9b7
# run the failing test in a loop until it hits
```
Will report back.
sre-oncall: If it's blocking deploys, we might revert the bump temporarily. I'll start drafting a revert PR, @Anna L. can you confirm rollback target?
Anna L.: Yes, revert PR ok if culprit found in bump. Let's wait for bisect result; if bisect points elsewhere, we avoid revert.
CI Bot: Rerun triggered by @Matt P.: https://ci.example.com/build/12457 — queued
Ryan K.: Bisect result: first bad commit: c7b2e0a — introduced a subtle change in eviction timing in libfoo. It updated `evict()` to signal later on failure. Patch: https://github.com/libfoo/libfoo/commit/c7b2e0a
Matt P.: Confirmed: building with libfoo pinned to previous behavior fixes test locally.
Anna L.: Thanks. Plan: 1) open a revert/lock in our dependency pins to avoid CI instability; 2) open an upstream issue for libfoo. @Ryan K. can you create the revert PR and link this thread? :thumbsup:
Ryan K.: On it. Creating PR to pin libfoo to 2.0.x (temporary rollback). I'll include the bisect notes and link to upstream commit. PR will reference c7b2e0a. ETA ~20m.
sre-oncall: Once PR is up, I'll trigger a rollout to confirm green and unblock deploys.
CI Bot: PR #4934 created by Ryan K. — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4934 — CI jobs running.
Matt P.: CI is green on linux lanes after PR merge. Good to go.
Anna L.: Great, closing the hunt. Follow-ups: add a unit test that asserts eviction timing contract and add a note in the libfoo issue. I'll assign follow-ups and ping the libfoo maintainers. Thanks everyone for the quick triage.
